title: Weekend Fun
subtitle: 考点：频率副词 / I usually ... on Saturday.

dialogue.t: What do you usually do at the weekend, Amy?
On Saturday I usually play ping-pong with my friends.
I visit my grandparents on Sunday. We have lunch together.
Sometimes I read in the evening. What about you?
I usually play chess on Saturday. Sometimes I help my father at home.

vocab: usually 通常 · weekend 周末 · Saturday 星期六 · Sunday 星期日 · visit 拜访 · grandparent 祖父母 · sometimes 有时

questions.stem: What does Amy usually do on Saturday?

questions.stem: What does Sam usually play on Saturday?
